batting.name: F du Plessis
batting.dismissal: c MA Starc b Harshit Rana

batting.name: GJ Maxwell
batting.dismissal: c RK Singh b SP Narine

batting.name: RM Patidar
batting.dismissal: c RK Singh b AD Russell

batting.name: Anuj Rawat
batting.dismissal: c PD Salt b Harshit Rana

batting.name: PD Salt
batting.dismissal: c C Green b Vijaykumar Vyshak

batting.name: VR Iyer
batting.dismissal: c V Kohli b Yash Dayal

balls.text: Moves across, and misses! Length ball going away, he does not make contact. They look to steal a bye but Salt hits the stumps at the striker's end with DK not making it in. RCB end on 182 for 6
Back of a length angling away, slaps it on the bounce to cover
Picks it up over fine leg Full on the pads, 145.1kph, he stays deep in the crease and helps it over
Short and angling away, pulled to deep square leg
Into the stands! Full on leg and middle, 129.4kph, Kohli stands still, gets a stride out and whips it over cow corner
Length ball on leg, he charges down and whips it to deep midwicket. There is a direct hit at the striker's end as he rushes back for two. He is in
Clears long-on, just! Length ball outside off, 134.3kph, Karthik flat-bats it over the leaping fielder
Back of a length slower one, outside off, he hops and looks to go over short third. But misses. Challenges the wide not called. Fair delivery
DK gets under and goes over! Full and outside off, 134.8kph, Karthik hits it hard and over long-off
Slower one full on off, once again fails to get it past the strip
Fuller on off, defended to the off side
On a length outside off, heaved across the line to deep midwicket for a single
Slower one again, slogs it to deep midwicket
Back of a length outside off, Kohli looks to punch it away but gets an inside edge onto his back pad
Slower one full on off and middle, tucked away to fine leg
Soft dismissal. Full offcutter outside off, Rawat looks to go over the off side. Gets a thick outside edge that carries low to Salt behind.
Another off-pace length ball, heaved away to deep midwicket
Flicked away through backward square leg for two
Looks to flick it away but gets an inside edge onto his pad and to the off side
Chakravarthy drops Rawat. Length ball angling away, he looks to glide it past short third but hits it straight to the fielder, who dives but fails to hang on
Length ball around leg, pulled through square leg

Catching practice for Rinku. Back of a length around off, 112.7kph, Patidar has to manufacture the power in his heave across the line. The bat turns in his hands and he hits it straight to deep midwicket. 100th IPL wicket for Dre Russ
Back of a length outside off, he hopes and looks to upper cut but misses
Full and outside off, drilled wide of long-off
Length ball around off, heaved through midwicket
Blasts it over cover. Length ball angling away, gets the timing right Kohli. It skips away from the practice surfaces into the fence
Bouncer around leg, he gets inside the line and looks to pull but misses. Wide called
Slower one on a length, hje looks to go over off but misses
Back of a length on the pads, heaved away to deep square leg
Back of a length, he charges down and heaves it to deep midwicket
Fuller outside off, 127.9kph, Kohli is a tad early into the shot and gets a thick inside edge to the wicketkeeper
Starts off with a length ball at 129.1kph, Kohli goes for the heave but misses
Goes back to whack one to the one side but gets a bottom edge to short fine leg
Kohli dives full length, is he in? Backs away and cuts a length ball through point. Rinku gets around and fields, and then fires a flat throw to the keeper. But the dive saves Kohli
Finds the gap. Tossed up full on off, he gets down on his knee after moving to leg. Plays the slog sweep between deep square leg and deep midwicket
Flatter and on a length on middle, eased through midwicket. They sprint hard and get two
Fuller outside off, he presses forward and pushes it towards covers for a quick one

Finally a KKR fielder holds on to a catch. Maxwell departs and Narine strikes. Lands one on a length outside off, gets it to bounce a bit more. Maxwell looks to go hard and gets a top edge towards deep point. Rinku runs in a fair bit and catches it, kisses the ball after that
Full on off, he moves across and mows it to deep square leg
Rubbing salt into the wounds. Full and outside off, Maxwell moves towards off and opens the face to get it between backward point and short third

Narine drops one now! Maxwell loses his shape as he looks to hack a slower one across the line. Gets a top edge towards short third, where Narine runs back but it goes through the gap between his hands and his body
Maxi-mum power! Stands tall and pulls the short ball from Rana off the front foot. Did not seem to have made a good contact but has enough to hit it over long-on
Full on the stumps, lofted over the non-striker
Slower one, full outside off, Maxwell has to delay his shot and slices it to deep point
Full on leg, driven to long-on
Flatter on middle, 85.1kph, worked away through midwicket
Fuller on middle, eased down to long-on
Fuller on off, eased to wide long-off
High and dropped! Tossed up on the stumps, Maxwell goes for the slog and gets more airtime than distance. Ramandeep gets around from deep midwicket but fails to hang on
Spins in sharply from a length outside off, 91.1kph, he goes back and misses the whip
Quicker on leg, turned away towards midwicket
And Maxwell goes straight! The GPS in his mind is working overtime. Tossed up on the stumps, he backs away again and slogs it over the bowler's head. Long-off was moved wider and so can't get around
Maxwell joins the party now. Tossed up outside off, he backs away and hacks it over the off side
Fires it on a length, heaved away to deep midwicket to bring up fifty.. Raises his bat, thumbs up toards the dugout and he goes on
Walloped! Lands it on a length, 100.9kph, Kohli gets down on a knee and slogs it well over deep midwicket
Tossed up ful on middle, drilled down to long-on
Off-pace on a length outside off, Maxwell misses. Salt does not collect it clean and they scamper a bye. The throw from Salt hits Maxwell on the back
Full and down leg, the slower one at 115.5kph, Maxwell goes for the sweep but it lobs off the glove and lands next to the pitch
Length again, 132.5kph, Maxi looks to steer it fine but is beaten
Length ball on off, defensive push through mid-on
Back of a length again, around off, Kohli cannot connect the pull. Passes just over off
Back of a length outside off, he misses the pull
Fuller on the pads, flicked towards short fine leg
Goes back to the length ball and punches it to deep point
Quicker and on the pads, he misses the flick
Flatter and outside off on a length, glided to short third
Fuller outside off, eased through cover
Flatter and spinning in from a length, he tucks it through forward square leg

Knocked him over! Six-and-out once again tonight. Russell fires it full on the pads, 131.4kph, Green looks to flick it away but misses. The ball ricochets off the back pad and the stumps light up. Russell is pumped up and so are KKR
Punished! Juicy full toss on the pads, Green won't get them easier than these. Whips it all the way over deep square leg
On a length outside off, Green looks to heave it away but gets an inside edge towards the keeper. 115.2kph
Full toss on middle, flicked to deep midwicket
Length ball, off-pace, outside off, 114.4kph, he looks to hit it across the line but gets an under-edge towards the keeper
On a length on off and middle, guided to deep third
Flatter and on off, looks to turn it across but gets a soft leading edge
Slogs it high and long. Fetch that! Tossed up full and just outside off, Kohli gets down on a knee and swipes it over deep midwicket
Kohli is cramped for room as he goes back to slap it through off
Kohli goes back to the length ball spinning in and deliberately lofts it over extra cover. Venkatesh gets aroune to his left from long-off and keeps it to two
Quicker and on a shortish length, 93kph, on middle, he backs away and slaps it through cover-point
Tossed up full and spinning in, Kohli aerially hits it towards long-on
Flatter and on a length on middle and leg, flicked through midwicket off the back foot
Pushes it wide of cover and sprints to the other end
Yorker on leg, dug out towards short third
Quicker on off, punched to cover,Kohli wants a run but is sent back
Slower through the air, outside off, punched to cover
Flatter and quicker on a length on leg, he goes back and heaves it away through midwicket

Green takes the aerial route! Backs away once again, but gets it full in his slot. He uses his long reach to power it over long-on. Narine had not conceded any boundary in the previous game, starts off with a 15-run over in his milestone match
Back-to-back fours! Backs away to the length ball outside off, slaps it hard through cover. Russell dives and gets a hand but the power is enough for it to race away
Swings hard and gets four. Spinning in from a length outside off, he gets down on a knee and slogs it off the inner half through square leg
Another one, where Green goes back and punches it to cover
Flatter and on a length around off, spinning in a touch, he goes back and punches it towards cover, where Ramandeep dives to hsi right
Tossed up full outside off, turns it across towards midwicket and takes a quick single
Once again Kohli charges down but Green does not move this tie. Goes back to keep out a fired in length ball but it rolls off his pad to short third
Flatter and wide outside off, slaps it to the left of cover, who dives and prevents any run
Quicker on leg, punched to mid-on
Slower through the air, full on the pads, Green eases it past wide mid-on. Deep midwicket gets around
Floated outside off, driven to long-off
Starts around the wicket and tosses it up, full on leg, he drives it to mid-on
Up and over! Back of a length outside off, 136.1kph, Green arches back and upper-cuts it fine over short third

Run-out chance goes abegging? Green punches one towards backward point and sets off. Kohli responds but sees Ramandeep get to the ball and aborts. Green has to turn back but gets back in after Raman does not cleanly pick up the ball
Back of a length outside off again, he stands tall and pulls it to deep square leg
Back of a length outside off, 138.3kph, Kohli goes for the pull but only connects with thin air
Ramandeep at it again! Hares after it from cover, dives and saves two. It was a length ball outside off that Kohli stood and punches over the off side
Full and outside off, Kohli slaps it through point, where Ramandeep gets a hand to it and slows it down. But he pushes it away from sweeper and the batters run two
Edged and four more! The edges are the new middle, eh? Length ball, angling away, Green goes for the drive. Gets a thick outside edge to the left of a diving short third
Back of a length on middle and leg, tucks it towards square leg, 143.6kph
Starc's pace helps Kohli. Length ball angling away, he opens the face and beats short third. Rinku hares to his left from deep backward point, dives and keeps it to two. Looked like a certain four
Thick inside edge! Fortunate Kohli. Starc bowls it on a length at 142.3kph on middle and leg. Kohli is a tad late in getting his bat down. Gets it just over the stumps
Wristy, effective, maximum! Full but on the pads. It is outside leg. Kohli gets his stride forward and nonchalantly whips it for half a dozen over deep midwicket. Bengaluru have found their voice
Length ball on middle, defended towards cover

And Rana has his revenge next ball! He is off and running in celebrations with his arms stretched. He bowls an offcutter on a length well outside off. Du Plessis once again goes for the scoop over short fine leg but couldn't counter the change of pace. Hits it straight to Starc in the circle. Early strike for KKR

Superb from du Plessis! Goes the distance. He shapes up to scoop it away pretty early. But Rana bowls it wide outside off. Yet du Plessis only stays still and directs it over deep third. Taking no-look six to another level
Hacks it across but does not find the boundary. Rinku does well running to his right from deep square leg. It was a length ball that was angled into Kohli
Back of a length on middle, 139.5kph, du Plessis hops and turns it towards backward square leg for one
Digs it short, du Plessis leaves it be. Wide called for height, and the  umpire signals first bouncer for the over as well
Length ball outside off, steers it to backward point
Starts with a length ball outside off, Kohli guides it straight to short third. 140.2kph to start
Full and swinging in on middle and leg, driven straight to mid-off. Du Plessis cannot believe he misses out on a half-volley
Length ball on off, defended back towards the bowler
Back of a length around off, squares Kohli up slightly, and he glides it with an open face to deep backward point
Full and well outside off, du Plessis pushes towards mid-off for a quick run
Full and outside off, driven straight to cover
Outside edge? Kohli plays it with soft hands though! The Chinnaswamy roars as he gets going with four. He almost guides it well past short third, who slides but is nowhere close to the ball

game set and match! Six over square leg and KKR win by seven wickets! Half-tracker on off and Shreyas goes deep in his crease before playing a whippy shot off his waist. Does it have the distance to clear deep midwicket? Oh yes, it does!
comes down the track and hammers this full ball to long off
good length ball just outside off. Cut to backward point
full ball on leg and clipped easily to wide long on. Shreyas calls for the second run late and the two batters push each other to get to the other end
good length ball on off and cut in front of square for a single
full ball on off and bunted to long on for a single. Dayal finishes with 1-46

good length ball on middle and off. Lets the ball get to him before opening the face and guiding to short third man's right. Fielder, Siraj, gets a fingertip to it with a dive but can't stop the ball. Kohli from backward point chases but fails to pull it back
short of good length angling into Rinku. Tries to pump a pull over square leg but mistimed to deep square leg
slower ball bouncer on middle. Rinku stands tall and yet the ball goes over him
full ball just outside off and he plays a square drive to the sweeper fielder on the off side
short ball angling into his throat. Semi-ducks while pulling and hits it really well to fine leg. On the bounce to the fielder

holes out straight after fifty and Dayal has something to celebrate. Pace-off length ball outside off. Venkatesh tries to tonk a pull over cow corner but this time he drags the shot. Kohli makes no mistake
shot of the day? Full ball searing into his toes, but Shreyas lets it land in front of him before using his strong wrists to close the bat's face and hammer a six over wide long on

short ball towards off and he comes down the track before flat-batting a mistimed shot to long on. Jogs across to reach his 13th T20 fifty at a strike-rate of 170+. Acknowledges the people standing up in the KKR dugout and offers some glove-love to Shreyas
good length ball angling across and he slaps a cut to point. To the fielder though
short ball angling across the batter. He tries to slap it over point but misses because the ball has gone too wide.
mistimes a shot to wide long on
full ball around off and he hammers a straight drive down the non-striker to long off
good length ball just outside leg stump. Skidding through to the keeper down the leg side
short ball, banged into the pitch, but doesn't really have the bounce to trouble the tall Venkatesh. Mows a pull over deep midwicket to start the over
good length ball on middle and leg. Pulled along the ground to deep midwicket. Finishes with 1/23
slower ball yorker on off but comfortably tapped to the off side for a quick single
overpitched ball on off but he can't get under it well. Drills a shot on the bounce to the fielder at long on
short ball angling in, and he pulls to fine leg for a single
full and wide outside off. Drilled to wide long off for a single
short and wide delivery, but he mistimes the cut to the off side
Length ball slanting in, clipped through midwicket
Once again dances down the track to a length ball and hacks it towards long-on
Length ball on off, punched towards cover
Venky gives him the charge now. Steps out as soon as the ball is released by Green, and smokes it over cover. Just lands inside the boundary
On a length and outside off, he goes for the drive but is beaten
Length ball on middle and leg, eased through midwicket
Short ball, angling away, Venky looks to upper cut it but misses. Checks with both the umps about the wide not given
Full toss on middle and leg, Shreyas' weight is not forward and only pushes it back past the non-striker
Slower one again, he charges down and hammers it wide of long-off
Shortish around off, controls the pull through forward square leg
Slower one on a length, he pushes it towards point and hares to the other end
Length ball on off, pulled all along the ground to deep backward square leg
Another bumper, another boundary. 145.9kph, Venkatesh goes for the pull again. It gets big on him and he gets a top edge well over the wicketkeeper

short ball outside leg. Venkatesh raises one leg and plays a Nataraja-style pull, clobbering it over fine leg! Six over but Iyer has injured himself while playing that shot. Back issue, perhaps, as the physio comes running out.
short ball through to the keeper as he misses the cut

back of a length ball angling across. Guides it to Dayal at deep third and it is a regulation stop but his luck is not good today in the field. Tries to slide and stop but his knees get stuck and he cannot stop the ball
short ball outside leg in a bid to cramp Venkatesh up. But he dances down the track and meets the ball a few metres down the crease before committing to a full-blooded pull over cow corner
back of a length delivery angling across the left-hander. Slapped to mid off's right

slower ball, but in the slot. Shreyas loses his shape while lifting it over cover, but nonetheless has enough power to atleast clear the infielders. Both cover and extra cover try to give the ball a chase
short ball on middle. This is full pace. Through to the keeper

catch to Dayal? No, the ball has gone through him! Short-ish ball angling into Shreyas and he swivels to pull. The shot has been hit straight to Dayal running in from fine leg, and he dives forward, but the ball goes under his fingers and squirts behind him. Green tried to retrieve the ball thereafter but his knee hit the rope while doing so

full ball just outside off. Shreyas keeps his eyes on the ball before lofting a shot over cover. Opts for timing over power, and gets two more with Joseph putting in the hard yards near the boundary line
short of good length on off. Stays in his crease and fends this slower-ball bouncer of sorts from the back foot
short ball to Shreyas, and he shapes up to pull but misses. Ball rattles his helmet and the physio comes running out. This was a slower-ball bouncer which is why Iyer got deceived.
full ball just outside off stump. Bit of turn away. Pushed to cover's left for a single
uses his feet again, but this time Dagar's delivery is flatter. Flicks it to square leg for a single
that's out of the ground! Team hundred too! Tossed up ball on middle and leg. Dances down the track and meets it under his eyeline. Then smacks it over wide long on for a maximum

faster one. Full ball just outside leg. Gets low to sweep but beaten by the pace. Hits his ankle and rolls away to short fine leg who stops the ball from going past. LBW appeal turned down and two leg-byes added to the total
full ball drifting and landing just outside off. Iyer throws his hands at this to muscle a shot through the off side, but misses it
full ball on off. Bit of turn away. Driven down the V, with the turn, to long off
good length ball outside off stump. Sticks the bat out and guides a tentative shot towards short third

buckethands Green grabs that! Short ball angling into him and Salt goes for a pull. But that's been drilled straight to the man who is guarding the deep square leg boundary. Big roar from Vyshak and Salt is gone for 30
short ball outside off. Salt tries to drag a pull to the leg side but misses out altogether
good length ball outside leg stump. A whippy flick off his thighs to send the ball to deep backward square leg
pace off. Good length ball, wider outside off. Checks a cut to the off side and calls for the single thereafter
good length ball around leg and angling to off. Iyer tries to flat-bat a shot down the V but absolutely mistimes it. Ball dribbles down to mid off
tucks this ball to wide mid on for a single
slices it, and in the air, but safe! Full outside off stump. Turning away. Skips down the track and tries to lift it over cover but mistimes it. Just over Kohli at cover
good length ball on middle and leg. Clipped off his waist to the leg side and Salt turns down the single

yorker, on off stump, and this crashes into the base of off stump! Wicket soon after the time-out and Narine will not get a landmark fifty in his 500th T20. He was too slow to bring the bat down, but to be fair, he's done his job tonight
continuing around the stumps to Narine. Length ball outside off and skidding across. Play and miss on the cut
good length ball on off from the left-arm orthodox spinner. Goes deep in his crease and pulls to deep midwicket
full ball on off stump. Swings across the line and hammers a shot to midwicket. But for a change, this is straight to the fielder. KKR 85/0 in six overs
good length ball angling into leg. Narine tries to flick, but it kisses his thigh before running away to the fine-leg boundary
straight as an arrow! When short didn't work, Dayal went full again. And Narine once again was waiting for that kind of delivery. Steady head and clobbered over long off
Narine expected that, didn't he? Short ball around off and even though Narine took his eyes of the ball, he pulled in front of square, and this has the legs for six more!

back of the hand slower ball, on a good length just outside off. Narine makes room and tries to flat-bat it over long off but he's through the shot early. Thick edge just past a diving short third fielder!
full ball outside off and he drives along the carpet to deep extra cover
full ball on middle and he mistimes a drive but squirts it towards cover. Misfielded, though, and that allows Narine to pinch two more

picked up off his waist! Siraj tries the slower ball at 118kph and Narine waited for the change-up. Arrives to him at waist-height after landing on a good length. And Narine dropkicks it over square leg
short ball on leg. Narine backs away while shaping up to slap a pull over the leg side. But he misses out on this occasion
short and wide. His eyes light up but toe-ends the cut, so the ball goes past Siraj to mid off instead
short ball around leg. Narine swivels and carefully checks a pull by playing it to the leg side for a single
back of a length ball angling into Salt. Tries the grounded pull but it hits his body

slower ball, full and wide. Salt loses his shape and doesn't keep his eyes on the ball while hitting it over cover. Sliced, in the air, but lands a few metres short of deep extra cover. Tidy Dayal over
back of a length ball on leg and the pull in front of square is intercepted by midwicket
just over midwicket! Not short enough to pull, but Salt goes for it anyway. It comes off the top-half of the bat but has enough power to tease du Plessis at midwicket before falling beyond him

fullish ball on middle. Salt offers minimal footwork and relies on his hand-eye co-ordination to play a cut from close to his body. But he gets it between backward point and short third! The backward point fielder gets a hand but cannot stop it. Team fifty in 3.3 overs
slower ball, overpitched and slightly wide. Salt had loaded up to smash it but is beaten by the 107kph ball. Drags a mistimed shot to Dayal again
good length ball on leg and angling to off. Drags a pull of sorts, but back to Dayal. Mis-hit

is that caught? No, just clears long on! This was a short ball that apparently got big on Narine but he made room before slapping a pull straight back. Mistimed shot, and Maxwell from mid-on is running back in a bid to catch it, but the ball wins this race.
short ball around leg. Narine flat-bats a mistimed pull back towards Joseph
clears the front leg and deposits it to long on! Full ball on leg, Narine ensures he's made enough room so that the bat swing is pure, and indeed it is! Sweet spot of the bat.

play and miss. Quick ball that rises after hitting the deck. Good length ball on leg and Narine backed away to hit him through the covers, but this 150kph delivery hurries him up, forcing him to miss out. Carried to the keeper at head height
back of a length ball, around leg. Angling towards off. Narine sees that length and lets it go on this occasion. Could've been wide on another day

good length ball around off. Narine stays in his crease and flat-bats a shot over the non-striker's head. But it's a sliced shot with the ball getting big on him, and Narine is lucky that clears mid-off. Fielders run after it and stop the four
peach of a delivery to Salt. Good length ball on leg and angling across to off. Salt tries to play a late dab across his body but missed it. Through to the keeper
back of a good length ball, just outside off. Stands leg-side of the ball and slaps a cut to cover
fullish ball outside off. Bit of movement away. Narine stands tall and flat-bats a shot, drilling it past mid off for four! Down the V
short ball, as expected at some point, but what you didn't expect is the bounce. Narine didn't bother ducking and the keeper's attempted stop is futile too. Free runs
full ball around off. Bit of swing away. Narine mistimes a drive but gets it just past mid off's right for a couple of runs
full ball on middle and leg. Driven past Narine to mid-off, but Maxwell dives to his right and stops the ball from squirting behind for a potential boundary
good length ball on off and angling into leg. Narine tries to flick it off his waist but misses. Hits his body and rolls away to deep third

slapped over long off! That's 18 in the over. Good length ball, fifth-stump line, bit of pace off. Salt stays in his crease and muscles a shot to pick it up over Siraj. Catch dropped by the ballkid beyond long off
yorker length on middle. Clears the front leg and toe-ends a drive to cover for a quick, scurrying single
full ball around off. Hangs back and taps it towards deep point for a single
good length ball, fifth-stump line. Too much width and Salt clatters a cut in front of square, clobbering it over cover
just misses ths second tier! Good length ball around off stump. Stays on the front foot and pulls from bottom to top, sending it over midwicket!
short of good length ball on a fourth-stump line. Tapped to the off side by riding the bounce
